content.title: Where to Stream Tonight’s High Point vs. Arkansas March Madness Basketball Game
content.text: Skip to main content Where to Stream Tonight’s High Point vs. Arkansas March Madness Basketball Game The No. 12 High Point Panthers are getting ready to battle it out with the No. 4 Arkansas Razorbacks. Here’s how you can catch the game online for free Soobum Im/Getty Images If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Rolling Stone may receive an affiliate commission. The second round of March Madness begins this weekend as the competition intensifies across the NCAA. One of the most talked-about matchups features the No. 12 High Point Panthers taking on the No. 4 Arkansas Razorbacks. At a Glance: How to Watch High Point vs. Arkansas March Madness Game Stream High Point vs. Arkansas: DirecTV, Sling, Hulu + Live TV TV channel: TBS Date, start time: Saturday, March 21 at 9:45 p.m. ET In the first round, High Point pulled off a major upset against the No. 5 Wisconsin Badgers in an 83–82 nail-biter, knocking down an impressive 15 three-pointers. Arkansas, on the other hand, cruised past the No. 13 Hawaii Rainbow Warriors with a dominant 97–78 win. If you don’t have access to cable to watch tonight’s game, here’s how you can tune in online for free. How to Stream High Point vs. Arkansas March Madness Game Online Tonight’s High Point vs. Arkansas game will air live on TBS on Saturday, March 21 at 9:45 p.m. EST. If you don’t have cable but still want to catch all the action, you can sign up for one of our favorite streaming services. Check out our top picks below for watching at the most affordable cost. DirecTV TBS is available in the MySports Genre Pack and all Signature Packages. TBS is included in several of DirecTV’s live TV streaming packages, making it easy to watch the High Point vs. Arkansas matchup. The MySports Genre Pack is the cheapest option at $69.99 per month and includes 20+ sports channels, while the larger Signature Packages offer up to 185+ channels. All plans offer a five-day free trial. Sling TBS is available in the Orange, Blue, and Orange + Blue packages. Sling is another option for streaming TBS, making it a solid choice for watching the High Point vs. Arkansas game tonight. The channel is available in Sling’s Orange, Blue, and Orange + Blue packages, which start at $45.99 per month. Sling also has Orange plan passes, including a one-day pass for $4.99, a three-day pass for $9.99, or a seven-day pass for $14.99. Keep in mind, Sling does not offer a free trial. Hulu + Live TV You can get access to TBS, plus more than 90 other channels with Hulu + Live TV. Hulu + Live TV is a great pick, with 90+ channels (including TBS) in its lineup, along with Disney+, ESPN, and Hulu for $89.99 per month. New subscribers get a three-day free trial, making it simple to stream the High Point vs. Arkansas game at no cost. High Point vs. Arkansas March Madness Game Date, Start Time The High Point vs. Arkansas March Madness game is scheduled for Saturday, March 21, with tip-off set for 9:45 p.m. EST. High Point vs. Arkansas Odds, Storylines Arkansas is favored to win tonight with a moneyline of -800, and a 11.5 spread. On Thursday, High Point defeated Wisconsin to secure the program’s first-ever win in an NCAA men’s basketball tournament game. After the victory, High Point coach Flynn Clayman said in a postgame interview with TBS, “It looks pretty obvious to me that high-majors need to play mid-majors during the season,” Clayman said. “Because they said we ain’t played nobody? We played somebody now.” Arkansas, on the other hand, is no stranger to success. The Razorbacks finished the regular season with a 26–8 record, led by SEC 2025 Player of the Year Darius Acuff Jr., who is averaging 22.9 points per game.
